value: Repository substitutions prevent conclusions about real storage contents, persistence, transaction failures, or Kafka delivery.
Observed declared statuses do not prove exhaustive status-code coverage; 500 paths were not exercised.
Accepting an input outside the schema shows broader runtime acceptance, not failure for a contract-valid client.
Matching a body against another media type schema does not resolve an undeclared response media type.
The recorded controller and DTO spans are compared with selected snapshot source. Program and substituted harness files are retained external evidence, not additional compiler-backed facts.
